name: Erdos176Lean.abs_cyclicAPSum_le
statement:
theorem abs_cyclicAPSum_le
    (f : Fin N → ℤ)
    (hpm : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1)
    (k : ℕ) (a : Fin N) (d : ℕ) :
    |cyclicAPSum f k a d| ≤ (k : ℤ)

name: Erdos176Lean.addChar_expect_mul_conj_eq_boole
statement:
theorem addChar_expect_mul_conj_eq_boole
    (ψ χ : AddChar (ZMod N) ℂ) :
    (Finset.univ.expect fun a : ZMod N => ψ a * starRingEnd ℂ (χ a))
      = if χ = ψ then 1 else 0

name: Erdos176Lean.card_wrapStarts_le
statement:
theorem card_wrapStarts_le (N m : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N)).filter fun a => N ≤ a.val + m).card ≤ m

name: Erdos176Lean.casselsGeomLowerClaim_true
statement:
theorem casselsGeomLowerClaim_true (k D : ℕ) :
    casselsGeomLowerClaim k D

name: Erdos176Lean.charCombination_fourierCoeff
statement:
theorem charCombination_fourierCoeff
    (f : ZMod N → ℂ) (a : ZMod N) :
    charCombination (fourierCoeff f) a = f a

name: Erdos176Lean.cyclicAPSum_eq_ordinaryAPSum
statement:
theorem cyclicAPSum_eq_ordinaryAPSum
    (f : Fin N → ℤ) (k : ℕ) (a : Fin N) (d : ℕ)
    (hnowrap : ¬ wraps (N := N) k a d) :
    cyclicAPSum f k a d = ordinaryAPSum f k a d hnowrap

name: Erdos176Lean.expect_charCombination_mul_conj
statement:
theorem expect_charCombination_mul_conj
    (c b : AddChar (ZMod N) ℂ → ℂ) :
    (Finset.univ.expect fun a : ZMod N =>
        charCombination c a * starRingEnd ℂ (charCombination b a))
      = ∑ ψ : AddChar (ZMod N) ℂ, c ψ * starRingEnd ℂ (b ψ)

name: Erdos176Lean.fejerPairEnergy_diag_lower
statement:
theorem fejerPairEnergy_diag_lower {z : ℂ} (hz : ‖z‖ = 1) (k D : ℕ) :
    (k : ℝ) * (D + 1 : ℝ) ≤ fejerPairEnergy z k D

name: Erdos176Lean.fourier_expansion
statement:
theorem fourier_expansion
    (f : ZMod N → ℂ) (x : ZMod N) :
    f x = ∑ ψ : AddChar (ZMod N) ℂ, fourierCoeff f ψ * ψ x

name: Erdos176Lean.htmlBoundNat_pos
statement:
theorem htmlBoundNat_pos (k : ℕ) :
    0 < htmlBoundNat k

name: Erdos176Lean.int_two_mul_succ_div_two_real
statement:
theorem int_two_mul_succ_div_two_real (k : ℕ) :
    ((((2 * k : ℤ) * (2 * k + 1 : ℤ)) / 2 : ℤ) : ℝ)
      = (k : ℝ) * (2 * k + 1 : ℝ)

name: Erdos176Lean.lowerTriangle_row_sum_le_sum_range_succ
statement:
theorem lowerTriangle_row_sum_le_sum_range_succ
    (F : ℕ → ℝ) (hF : ∀ d, 0 ≤ F d) {r D : ℕ} (hr : r ≤ D) :
    (∑ s ∈ Finset.range r, F (r - s)) ≤
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range D, F (i + 1)

name: Erdos176Lean.lowerTriangle_sum_le_mul_sum_range_succ
statement:
theorem lowerTriangle_sum_le_mul_sum_range_succ
    (F : ℕ → ℝ) (hF : ∀ d, 0 ≤ F d) (D : ℕ) :
    (∑ r ∈ Finset.range (D + 1), ∑ s ∈ Finset.range r, F (r - s)) ≤
      (D + 1 : ℝ) * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range D, F (i + 1))

name: Erdos176Lean.square_sum_eq_lower_diag_upper
statement:
theorem square_sum_eq_lower_diag_upper (F : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ r ∈ Finset.range n, ∑ s ∈ Finset.range n, F r s) =
      (∑ r ∈ Finset.range n, ∑ s ∈ Finset.range r, F r s)
        + (∑ r ∈ Finset.range n, F r r)
        + (∑ s ∈ Finset.range n, ∑ r ∈ Finset.range s, F r s)

name: Erdos176Lean.sum_Ico_one_succ_eq_sum_range_succ
statement:
theorem sum_Ico_one_succ_eq_sum_range_succ (F : ℕ → ℝ) (D : ℕ) :
    (∑ d ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (D + 1), F d) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range D, F (i + 1)

name: Erdos176Lean.sum_Ico_one_succ_le_sum_range_succ
statement:
theorem sum_Ico_one_succ_le_sum_range_succ
    (F : ℕ → ℝ) (hF : ∀ d, 0 ≤ F d) {r D : ℕ} (hr : r ≤ D) :
    (∑ d ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (r + 1), F d) ≤
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range D, F (i + 1)

name: Erdos176Lean.sum_range_succ_int
statement:
theorem sum_range_succ_int (D : ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range D, (((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)))
      = ((D * (D + 1) / 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)

name: Erdos176Lean.sum_range_succ_nat
statement:
theorem sum_range_succ_nat (D : ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range D, (i + 1)) = D * (D + 1) / 2

name: Erdos176Lean.zmodColoringOfFin_unit
statement:
theorem zmodColoringOfFin_unit
    (f : Fin N → ℤ) (hpm : ∀ x, f x = -1 ∨ f x = 1) :
    ∀ x : ZMod N, ‖zmodColoringOfFin f x‖ = 1

name: Erdos176Lean.fejerWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem fejerWeight_nonneg {D d : ℕ} (hd : d ≤ D) :
    0 ≤ fejerWeight D d

name: Erdos176Lean.lowerTriangle_sum_eq_weighted_count
statement:
theorem lowerTriangle_sum_eq_weighted_count (F : ℕ → ℝ) (D : ℕ) :
    (∑ r ∈ Finset.range (D + 1), ∑ s ∈ Finset.range r, F (r - s)) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range D, ((D - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * F (i + 1)

name: Erdos176Lean.sqrtHtmlBoundNat_pos
statement:
theorem sqrtHtmlBoundNat_pos (k : ℕ) :
    0 < sqrtHtmlBoundNat k

name: Erdos176Lean.sqrtHtmlThresholdReal_lt_of_sqrtHtmlBoundNat_le
statement:
theorem sqrtHtmlThresholdReal_lt_of_sqrtHtmlBoundNat_le
    {k N : ℕ}
    (hN : sqrtHtmlBoundNat k ≤ N) :
    sqrtHtmlThresholdReal k < (N : ℝ)

name: Erdos176Lean.sqrtHtmlThresholdReal_lt_sqrtHtmlBoundNat
statement:
theorem sqrtHtmlThresholdReal_lt_sqrtHtmlBoundNat (k : ℕ) :
    sqrtHtmlThresholdReal k < (sqrtHtmlBoundNat k : ℝ)

name: Erdos176Lean.sum_fejerWeight_range
statement:
theorem sum_fejerWeight_range (D : ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range D, fejerWeight D (i + 1)) = (D : ℝ) / 2

name: Erdos176Lean.sum_mul_fejerWeight_range
statement:
theorem sum_mul_fejerWeight_range (D : ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range D, (((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * fejerWeight D (i + 1)))
      = (D : ℝ) * (D + 2 : ℝ) / 6

name: Erdos176Lean.sum_range_succ_real
statement:
theorem sum_range_succ_real (D : ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range D, (((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)))
      = (D : ℝ) * (D + 1 : ℝ) / 2
